iterations.theme: Introductory collage, reflection on Goran Bare, space missions, and new viruses

sections.subtitle: From the pandemic and the introduction of the euro to totalitarian surveillance: An audio-visual collage
sections.screenshot_description: Archival footage of a politician explaining the effect of converting the kuna to the euro on the price of coffee.
sections.content:
The show begins with a dynamic and extensive audio-visual collage that sets the tone for the analysis of contemporary social, political, and technological phenomena. The collage opens with a brief statement by **Goran Bare** on the historical subjugation of these regions under **Austria-Hungary** and **Turkey**, followed by a series of archival clips from the pandemic era. In them, unnamed public officials appeal to older fellow citizens to understand the importance of vaccination, call out Saturday protesters for the motto *"think of yourself, endanger others"*, and raise the question of trust in experts. Particularly notable is a statement by a speaker from medical or scientific circles commenting on vaccine testing, stating that numerous Western vaccines were previously tested on children in poor areas and orphanages in **Asia** and **Africa**, whereas now for the first time they are also being tested on European and American children.

This is followed by a block dedicated to economic promises in **Croatia**. Statements by politicians ahead of the introduction of the euro are shown, claiming that the effect of converting the kuna to the euro on the growth of consumer prices will be mild and one-off, only **0.23 percent**, which is vividly described as an increase in the price of an average coffee by only **two lipa**. Along with mentioning demographic revitalization, decarbonization, green transition, and digital transformation, the collage also reminds viewers of contradictory statements by politicians (among whom Mr. **Radić** is mentioned) regarding the introduction of a real estate tax – from resolutely denying such an option in the election program to explaining that the goal is to more fairly shift the tax burden from labor to property, that is, real estate.

The second part of the introductory collage shifts the focus to global technological and geopolitical topics. Alongside clips in English about robotics and the lost technology of the Moon landing, the concept of the **Social Credit System** (*Social Credit System*) is analyzed in detail. The speaker in the clip explains how traditional money (gold coins, dollars, and even bitcoin) assigns value only to specific economic actions, whereas social credit monitors absolutely everything and assigns a point value to every human action – from visiting one's grandmother to throwing trash on the street. It is warned that such a system in **China** and around the world has the potential to create the most totalitarian regime in history, where algorithms, smartphones, cameras, and microphones replace the former **KGB** agents in the **Soviet Union**, enabling total surveillance over hundreds of millions of citizens without any privacy.

The collage concludes with political speeches featuring **Donald J. Trump**, speaking about artificial intelligence, quantum computing, and the leadership of the **United States of America**, as well as statements by commentators who believe in **Trump's** return to power as the 47th President of the **USA**, connecting him with the declaration of **Jerusalem** as the capital of **Israel**, the topic of the **Third Temple**, and the issue of the Iranian nuclear program.

sections.subtitle: Goran Bare on false patriotism and the looting of the state
sections.screenshot_description: A clip from an interview in which Goran Bare talks about what true patriotism represents for him.
sections.content:
After the introductory collage, a striking clip from an interview with Vinkovci rock musician **Goran Bare** is shown in its entirety. In conversation with a journalist, **Bare** presents a sharp diagnosis of the Croatian mentality and attitude toward one's own state, drawing a parallel with historical periods in which the people were always under foreign rule, such as **Austria-Hungary** or **Turkey**.

According to **Bare's** words, the fundamental problem lies in the fact that people in **Croatia** do not actually love their country. Comparing Croats with other European nations, the musician points out that **Germans**, **Englishmen**, and **Frenchmen** truly love and adore their countries, regardless of historical figures like **Napoleon** or **Marie Antoinette**, whereas in **Croatia**, love for the homeland is only feigned.

> "A Croat pretends to love Croatia. He doesn't love it, they are looting it, you get it? People here are looting. Well, that's awful... How can someone be a patriot who steals from his fellow Croat brother? What kind of patriotism is that? For me, patriotism is when you love your country. I love Croatia, I am a Croat, I love Croatia and I do not want to steal from the country. I want to contribute, I want to create, and not destroy."

To the journalist's question of who allows such a state of affairs and in whose interest it is, **Bare** replies that it is a deeply rooted problem of a people in whom love for the homeland was never instilled in the right way. He concludes that things will only be good in the state when people start to truly love it and create, instead of stealing from it while simultaneously declaratively calling themselves great patriots.

sections.subtitle: Filip's homage to his fellow citizen, 'weekend right-wingers', and the channel's fifth birthday
sections.screenshot_description: Host Filip in the studio commenting on the clip of Goran Bare and addressing the viewers.
sections.content:
Going live in the 207th episode of the podcast *Bez dlake na glavi*, host **Filip** explains why he dedicated the opening minutes precisely to the frontman of the band **Majke** (later **Bare i plaćenici**). As a native of Vinkovci, **Filip** points out that he felt a human and fellow-citizen need to pay a sort of *homage* to the musician whose work he listened to, specifically singling out the poster for the concert at **Tvornica** as a masterpiece.

The host reflects on the public perception that often labeled **Goran Bare** as a leftist, commie, or Yugo-nostalgic simply because his song *"Vrijeme je da se krene"* was used in the political campaign of **Ivica Račan** and **Dražen Budiša**, and later **Zoran Milanović**. **Filip** emphasizes that in the shown clip, **Bare** actually detected the phenomenon of the so-called "weekend right-wingers" – not those people who sincerely love their people and homeland, but those who loudly beat their chests and scream to convince others of their patriotism. Comparing him to **Dino Dvornik**, the host adds that **Bare** never shied away from the fact that drugs are bad, but rather served with his own life as a warning to others, while retaining his sharpness and complete indifference to other people's opinions.

After announcing the topics of tonight's gathering – which include **Donald J. Trump**, **Mike Tyson**, **Susan Dell**, and the cult 1980s film *They Live* – **Filip** greets the numerous viewers in the chat and thanks the donors who financially support his work. In doing so, he reveals an important anniversary: in three days, the channel *Bez dlake na glavi* celebrates its **fifth birthday**.

- The first video on the channel was published five years ago under the title *"Heartbreaking Beginning"*, and dealt with the topic of myocarditis and pericarditis as consequences of vaccination against the coronavirus.
- From then until 2026, around **600 videos** have been published on the channel.
- **Filip** notes with a dose of irony that he and his audience are still alive and healthy, despite the dark prophecies of television personalities who frightened citizens 24/7 during the pandemic and acted as "traveling salesmen of the pharma-mafia".

sections.subtitle: NASA's lost technology and forgotten walking after returning from space
sections.screenshot_description: Filip showing a photograph of a female scientist next to a large stack of paper with codes for the Moon landing.
sections.content:
The first thematic unit of the evening is dedicated to space missions and skepticism toward the official narratives of **NASA**. The occasion for the commentary is the news of the death of the woman whose programming code was crucial for the first human landing on the Moon. **Filip** shows a famous photograph from the sixties in which the mentioned scientist stands next to a huge stack of paper with printed code, with an ironic remark that **NASA** has in the meantime managed to lose all those documents and the accompanying technology.

To substantiate this claim, the host replays an archival statement by an astronaut (whom he calls **Bob Petit**), who openly admits that they would gladly go to the Moon again today, but that this technology was destroyed and that rebuilding it is a painful process. **Filip** points out the absurdity of such an explanation in an era when the entire computing power of that mission fit into an ordinary calculator or a millionth part of today's smartphone, and yet missions to Mars are being announced today.

Continuing, he reflects on current space flights and the return of the international crew in **Elon Musk's** spacecraft. In the photograph of the crew, which includes one Russian, two Americans, and the French astronaut **Sophie Adenot** (who the media state spent the longest time in space), **Filip** finds proof of the fictitiousness of geopolitical conflicts:

- While irreconcilable political tensions allegedly reign on Earth, Russians, Americans, and the French cooperate harmoniously in space missions.
- The host expresses hope that the French astronaut will not have problems like the astronaut (whom he calls **Kristina Hamon** in the broadcast), who walked normally in front of the cameras on the day of her return from space, only to state a week later that due to the lack of gravity she "forgot how to walk".
- **Filip** also adds brief remarks about the physical properties of a vacuum, such as the fact that human blood boils in a vacuum and that sound cannot propagate in it.

sections.subtitle: Plague in Siberia, the role of the WHO, and an 'inflation' of 11 thousand viruses in the Pacific Ocean
sections.screenshot_description: Display of a media article with a headline about the spread of the plague in Siberia and an FSB escort.
sections.content:
Moving from space topics to health and geopolitical news, **Filip** analyzes media reports under the headline *"Plague in Siberia is getting out of control, the disease has entered hospitals, FSB escorts ambulances"*. The host draws a direct parallel between the alleged escort by the Russian security service **FSB** and scenes from the time of the coronavirus pandemic, when armed personnel with long barrels guarded vaccine shipments in order to create a psychological impression in the public of the exceptional value and desirability of that product, before coercions and movement restrictions were introduced.

This news serves **Filip** to deconstruct the division of the world into "good" and "bad" states. Although many observers today see **Russia**, **China**, and **Iran** as a positive counterweight to the West, the host points out that this very same **Russia** "nerdily" and dutifully reports all its cases to the **World Health Organization (WHO)**. According to his interpretation, a geopolitical wait is underway for the political pendulum in the **USA** to swing back after **Donald J. Trump**, who in principle withdrew the country from that organization. When **America** returns to the **WHO**, conditions will be created for declaring a new pandemic, for which some animal will once again be found as the culprit – whether it is a bat, a badger, a seagull from a landfill (mentioning the hantavirus), or a spider from a laboratory. **Filip** dabei expresses his personal view that behind the stories of viruses that jump and kill, there are actually biological weapons, radiation, and other invisible phenomena that cause identical symptoms.

As the pinnacle of media fearmongering with invisible enemies, the host shows an article about the discovery of as many as **11,000 almost unknown viruses** at the bottom of the **Pacific Ocean**. Reminding viewers how in 2020 they presented the coronavirus as completely unknown in order to justify the emergency use of vaccines through Operation *Warp Speed* – even though biology textbooks from the seventies of the last century mention the coronavirus as an ordinary cause of the common cold – **Filip** concludes the chapter with a satirical economic analogy:

- Just as central banks print money without backing in the form of debt and thereby create inflation that devalues the currency, so too has the **Pacific Ocean** become a sort of "central bank of viruses".
- With the discovery of 11 thousand new pathogens, a true "inflation of viruses" has been created, which ultimately means that each individual virus will actually be worth less and less in the eyes of the public.

iterations.theme: Suspension of vaccines for newborns, presentation by Alma Demirović, and current Croatian topics

sections.subtitle: Urgent suspension of vaccines for newborns and the issue of delayed side effects
sections.screenshot_description: Host Filip displays and comments on a media article about the urgent suspension of vaccines for newborns and a statement by Pavić Šimetin.
sections.content:
Moving on to more serious topics that form the very foundation of his channel's creation, host Filip reflects on the news of the urgent suspension of the tuberculosis vaccine for newborns due to an increase in the number of reported side effects. He pays special attention to the statement by **Pavić Šimetin**, who states in the article that symptoms can appear from a few months to several years after vaccination, and most often after a year, noting that with timely diagnosis and treatment, a complete recovery occurs.

Filip ironically notes that this time it is the recovery that is 'safe and effective', while the vaccine itself has proven to be the opposite. He points out that precisely the fact that symptoms can appear months or years later confirms the arguments for which skeptics once compared vaccines to rat poison. He explains this analogy: rats are extremely intelligent animals, and if they saw another rat drop dead immediately after consuming poison, the others would not touch it. Therefore, such substances act with a time delay.

In Filip's opinion, the same principle can be applied to the vaccination from 2021, after which numerous health problems appeared with a time delay, such as so-called turbo cancers and heart and blood pressure problems. In doing so, he considers the term **'consequence'** much more precise than the word 'side effect', and emphasizes the absurdity of a system in which doctors – whom he calls traveling salesmen of the pharma-mafia – most often refuse to accept reports of side effects that happen on the same day or after a few days, let alone after several months.

Continuing, he reflects on a statement by a doctor who claims that the suspension of the vaccine after just a few reports proves that the system works and that institutions are responsible. Filip responds to him directly by reminding viewers of an event from five years and five days ago in front of **KBC Rebro**. At that time, he personally filmed former Minister **Beroš**, who had previously commented on the death of a young Slovenian woman after vaccination with **AstraZeneca** with the saying that 'one swallow does not make a spring'. To Filip's direct question of how many 'swallows' are needed to suspend vaccination, Beroš replied: 'More than one'. The host concludes that during the pandemic, families were terrorized and children were called 'bags of viruses', while today society wonders at the rise in anxiety, depression, and various physical disorders among the youngest.

sections.subtitle: Shocking revelation by Alma Demirović: HALMED has not conducted a single laboratory analysis of vaccines in five years
sections.screenshot_description: Video address by physician Alma Demirović regarding the inquiry sent to HALMED.
sections.content:
To substantiate his claims before skeptics who still blindly trust experts, Filip plays a video address by physician **Alma Demirović**. In her presentation, she presents exclusive data on the quality control of vaccines on the market in the **Republic of Croatia**. Demirović notes that the vast majority of citizens live under the belief that competent institutions conduct routine controls of vaccine contents, just as inspections are conducted on food, toys, or cosmetic products that are withdrawn from the market when dangerous substances are found in them.

Prompted by great public interest in vaccine safety, Alma Demirović, on behalf of the **Croatian Association of Parent Activists**, sent an official inquiry to the **Agency for Medicinal Products and Medical Devices (HALMED)**, whose job description implies ensuring the quality and safety of medicines and vaccines. Her inquiry contained two very specific questions:
- Is there a laboratory within the Agency where an analysis of the contents of a vaccine vial can be performed?
- How many such analyses have been done in the last five years, and are there official reports on them?

Soon, an official response from HALMED arrived, revealing a devastating fact: a laboratory for testing medicines exists within the Agency, but in the last five years **not a single analysis checking the contents of vaccine vials has been performed**, and consequently, no reports exist. Demirović clarifies that when approving vaccines, the Agency conducts exclusively an administrative check of documentation, accepting a quality certificate issued by one of the laboratories within the **European Union**. The entire correspondence was published on the website *Cijepljenje.info*.

Filip comments on these allegations in disbelief, wondering what HALMED employees even receive a salary for, other than literally stamping documents that others have already approved. He adds that the Agency did not even bother to falsify data about controls. The host then shares a personal experience, pointing out that he had the honor of meeting Dr. Demirović, whose own child suffered harm from a vaccine. He also recalls an earlier video in which the head of HALMED, upon being asked by Dr. Demirović about recording all side effects, stated that it was 'inhumane' because doctors would not have time for anything else. Filip concludes that the very existence of such an agency is inhumane, especially toward small children who cannot articulate pain in words after vaccination, while in the system, with rare exceptions like physicians **Nada Jurinčić** and **Lidija Gajski**, they are systematically ignored.

sections.subtitle: Media spins around the Split protest and the paradox of modern medicine
sections.screenshot_description: Display of a newspaper article with a headline about a protest in Split over the suspension of baby vaccinations.
sections.content:
Continuing the topic of vaccination, Filip analyzes the way mainstream media report on citizen initiatives. He shows an article headline that reads: *'Protest in Split over the suspension of vaccinating babies against tuberculosis'*. The host asks the audience what first comes to their mind when reading such a headline, admitting that at first he himself thought that parents were protesting because they could no longer vaccinate their children with a preparation that was admitted to be problematic.

However, after researching in more detail the work of the association organizing the gathering scheduled for October 18 in **Split**, he realized that it was a media manipulation. The association, namely, advocates for parents' right to free choice and the possibility of refusing questionable medical products without legal sanctions and conditioning. Although Filip notes that he does not like the fact that representatives of the association publicly distance themselves from so-called 'anti-vaxxers' and 'conspiracy theories', he emphasizes that he unconditionally supports every initiative that defends the right of parents to decide for themselves about the health of their children. In doing so, he warns of an alarming increase in the number of students with special needs, learning difficulties, and autism in high schools over the last twenty years.

In interaction with viewers, who mention bans on natural healing and traditional diet in the comments, Filip relays information he received from his friend **Boris** about the benefits of using pure linen blankets for newborns due to its high natural frequency. He also agrees with a comment by viewer **Luka Botica** that autism probably does not have just one exclusive cause, but is rather a combination of numerous factors, including chemicals and dyes in food, polluted air, water, and ubiquitous radiation.

Concluding the medical block, Filip reminds viewers how modern medicine was completely reshaped in 1910 under the financial patronage of **Rockefeller** and **Carnegie**. Natural healing was declared an alternative, while chemistry became the standard. He points out the key paradox of today: never in history have there been more scientists, medical breakthroughs, and medicines, and at the same time, never have there been more sick people. He sees the explanation in the fact that medicine is controlled by the pharmaceutical industry, and for its survival and profit, consumers – that is, sick people – are necessary. He compares this to giants of the military industry like **Lockheed Martin** and **Rheinmetall**, for whom world peace is never in their interest because they live off wars and tensions.

sections.subtitle: Mysterious stench in Zagreb, waste incineration in Našice, and 'climate' fires
sections.screenshot_description: Media headline about a mysterious stench spreading through Zagreb.
sections.content:
Moving on to current ecological problems in Croatia, Filip reflects on the news about a mysterious stench that spread through **Zagreb** for days. Without hesitation, he describes how the city literally smelled like a combination of feces and carrion, whereby **Agroproteinka** was also mentioned in public as a possible source.

However, the problem with air pollution is not isolated only to the capital city. The host draws attention to the situation in **Našice**, where it has been confirmed that waste previously illegally dumped in **Gospić** is now being incinerated in the local cement plant. Filip sharply criticizes the **Government of the Republic of Croatia**, pointing out that the state decided to solve the problem of garbage imported by the Italian mafia by simply burning it in a cement plant. With heavy irony, he addresses the citizens of Našice, telling them 'not to be mimosas' and to breathe in that polluted air deeply for the wellbeing of the patriotic Government and future generations.

In the same sarcastic tone, Filip comments on the frequent fires in recycling yards and landfills across the country, attributing them to 'climate change'. He cites the datum that as many as 24 facilities owned by one controversial Zagreb entrepreneur were engulfed in fires. Alongside **Pula** and Našice, tons of waste suddenly started burning on the island of **Rab** as well. The host concludes that it is obviously a matter of deliberate burning of evidence after dust was raised in public over the import of hazardous waste and connections with the mafia, while citizens are served stories about droughts and extreme weather conditions.
entities: Government of the Republic of Croatia

sections.subtitle: State investments in stadiums, the hypocrisy of Moody's agency, and the systematic destruction of domestic production
sections.screenshot_description: Article about the Government allocating 55 million euros for sports halls and the stadium in Split.
sections.content:
As a state 'antibiotic' for ecological disasters and waste scandals in Gospić, Filip cites investments in sports infrastructure. He comments on the statement by Split's HDZ mayor **Šuta** that the Government is giving almost 55 million euros for sports halls and the stadium in **Split**. The host contrasts this news with photographs of Split's neglected train and bus stations, which look as if they have not been renovated since the seventies or eighties of the last century, with a cynical remark that the various air conditioners on the facade probably represent a blend of modern architecture and Dalmatian authenticity.

Furthermore, he analyzes the praises from the credit rating agency **Moody's**, which maintained Croatia's high credit rating. Filip explains that such agencies are not interested in garbage and mafia scandals, but exclusively in implementing globalist agendas: facilitating the import of foreign workers, the emigration of the domestic population, and the introduction of a real estate tax. He reminds the audience that precisely agencies like Moody's, **Fitch**, and **Standard & Poor's** were directly responsible for the global financial crisis in 2008 because they gave false ratings to banks, and were never held accountable for it.

In the context of squeezing out the domestic population, Filip reflects on the protest of small landlords and entrepreneurs in which **Hana Matić** also participated. Although he admits that criticisms regarding greed and unjustified price hikes in tourism are often well-founded, the host firmly takes the side of domestic landlords. He believes that the state is purposefully destroying small entrepreneurs to open up space for foreign hotel and retail chains that will import their own workforce and food, and take all the profit out of Croatia.

He sees the same pattern of destroying domestic production in agriculture:
- **Lukač Farm**: Due to alleged salmonella and bird flu, 300,000 chickens belonging to a domestic egg producer were culled, thereby opening up space for foreign oligarchs.
- **Slavonian pig farmers**: They are being systematically destroyed under the pretext of disease in order to establish an import monopoly.
- **Import of honey and grain**: European and Croatian beekeepers warn of the danger of privileged honey imports from third countries via **Armenia**, following the same model by which the market was flooded with cheap grain from **Ukraine**.

Filip concludes that in Croatia there is almost no profession that is not systematically suppressed in favor of foreign interests, while politicians divert public attention to external enemies from the East.

sections.subtitle: Interaction with the audience and hidden meanings in the English language
sections.screenshot_description: Host Filip analyzing English expressions and compound words in conversation with the audience.
sections.content:
In the final part of this block, Filip takes time to read comments from viewers following the live broadcast. He agrees with viewer **Vlasta**, who points out that all presidents and prime ministers are merely obedient poodles implementing transhumanism and the fourth industrial revolution.

Prompted by a question from a viewer in the chat about the hidden meaning of the English word *soldier*, Filip presents his view of the English language, calling it the 'language of witches'. As the most famous example, he cites the word for spelling out letters – **'spelling'**, which in English simultaneously denotes casting a spell or curse (*to cast a spell*).

In addition, he reminds viewers of the analysis of the word **'government'**, which he has dealt with earlier on the channel. He explains that this compound word is made up of a verb denoting governing or control and the Latin word *mens* (mind, mental), which ultimately literally means 'mind control'. To a comment by one of the viewers that the German language is much better and more precise than English, Filip agrees and jokingly speaks a few sentences in German, thanking the audience for donations and support before moving on to European topics.

iterations.theme: European crisis, geopolitical paradoxes around Nord Stream, and the political spectacle of Donald J. Trump

sections.subtitle: Occupied Europe, riots in France, and a prophetic poster from the 1930s
sections.screenshot_description: Host Filip displays and analyzes a historical illustration from the 1930s predicting the demographic future of Paris in a hundred years.
sections.content:
Moving from domestic to European topics, host **Filip** reflects on current events in **France**, where large riots, protests, burned schools, smashed shops, burned-out cars, and clashes with mounted police rule the streets, including incidents in which police officers were attacked and teachers were doused with gasoline. Parallel to this internal chaos, Filip highlights the news that **Germany** is giving **Ukraine** another billion euros in military aid. In his opinion, these two events are clear proof of how occupied **Europe** actually is.

Speaking of the historical context, the host notes that for states that were colonial powers for a long time – such as the **British Empire**, France, **Belgium**, and the **Netherlands** – such a policy must sooner or later backfire like a boomerang. In doing so, he draws a parallel with **Croatia**, noting that although it historically had no colonies, since 2015 and 2020 it has entered a similar pattern of behavior because it grabs foreign workers and treats them almost like slaves, which also carries its own price.

As visual proof of demographic and social changes, Filip shows viewers an authentic illustration from the 1930s, created at a time when Hitler (whom he calls "Brcko" in the broadcast) had already come to power in Germany. The poster titled *The Siege of France in 100 Years* depicts Paris in the future with the caption: *"The last white Frenchmen form an attraction in Paris"*. The illustration shows two white French people dressed in expensive suits and with classic hairstyles from the twenties and thirties of the last century, but placed in a pool like seals in a zoo while a crowd of dark-skinned people watches them. Although he notes that racism as such does not exist for him because he believes it was invented in the same kitchen that sells fears and political correctness, and admits that Black people on the poster might be depicted mockingly, Filip asks the audience a key question: were the authors of that illustration wrong? He concludes that the prediction from the 1930s hit the situation a hundred years later with incredible precision, noting that today Germany itself is in no better position than France.

sections.subtitle: Geopolitical circus: Trump's instructions to Zelensky and admission of destroying Nord Stream 2
sections.screenshot_description: Footage of Donald J. Trump from 2024 in conversation with Tucker Carlson talking about how he stopped Nord Stream 2.
sections.content:
Continuing the show, **Filip** analyzes statements by **Donald J. Trump**, showing video clips in which the former and future US president comments on the war in **Ukraine** and attacks on Russian energy infrastructure. In the shown speech, Trump points out that Ukrainian President **Zelensky** (whom the host calls "the green one") is creating a huge problem for the whole world and American farmers because he is bombing Russian refineries, which consequently causes a diesel shortage. In doing so, Trump acts like a father telling a child that he can do whatever he wants and hit any other targets in **Russia**, just not to touch the refineries.

The host points out the absurdity of such a situation, reminding viewers that in that very same political "movie", Trump brags about having spoken on the phone with Russian President **Putin** the night before. Filip asks a logical question: what kind of friend allows attacks on everything except refineries, and what kind of leader to Russia is Putin if he tolerates such a partner with whom he simultaneously arranges oil deliveries? In Filip's opinion, this circus only proves that all world leaders are guided from the same center of power.

To shatter the illusions of viewers who still believe in Trump's fight against the "deep state" and his constantly repeated phrase that the war would never have happened if he had been president, Filip plays archival footage. In a clip from 2024 with **Tucker Carlson**, as well as at a later G7 meeting with the Canadian prime minister, Trump openly admits: *"I killed Nord Stream 2"*, calling it the largest gas pipeline in the world leading from Russia to **Germany** and all of **Europe**, and brags about how he stopped everything while Germany depended on Russian energy sources. To prove that it does not matter at all who sits in the **White House** and that the division into left and right is false, Filip immediately thereafter shows a statement by **Biden** from 2022, who also promised the end of **Nord Stream 2**. The conclusion is clear: both agreed perfectly on destroying European energy independence, leaving a vassal Europe in huge problems.

sections.subtitle: The vassal fate of Europe and the global unity of elites behind the scenes
sections.screenshot_description: Host Filip explaining his thesis on the joint action of world powers using the example of international space missions.
sections.content:
Analyzing the position of the European continent, **Filip** recalls the symbolism of the statue standing in front of the European Parliament, which depicts the myth of **Zeus** and **Europa**, in which Zeus actually rapes Europa. He leaves it as "homework" for the viewers to research for themselves which religious circles openly say they cannot stand Europe because they equate it with the **Roman Empire**. At the same time, the host distances himself from taking sides with **Putin**, **Zelensky**, or any other actor. Regarding the Ukrainian president, he reminds viewers that he is an actor who once played the piano with his genitals, entertained the Russian elite in fluent Russian on state television in 2013 or 2014, and then got a television series in which he plays a president fighting against oligarchs – only for oligarchs to bring him to power in real life.

Filip emphasizes his key mantra for understanding geopolitics: one should not look at where political actors and states feign differences and conflicts, but exclusively at where they act in complete harmony. As the most important examples of this global unity behind the scenes, he cites:
- **Space missions:** In **Elon Musk's** spacecraft and international stations, Russians, Americans, and the French sit together, even though they are allegedly mortal enemies on Earth.
- **The Antarctic Treaty:** All world powers without exception respect the same agreement.
- **The World Health Organization (WHO) and the pandemic:** Russia dutifully and "nerdily" reports plague cases in **Siberia** to the **WHO**, and even **Iran** participated in the vaccination campaign, whereby the Ayatollah himself was photographed with a band-aid on his shoulder.

In contrast to them, several African leaders who dared to mock the entire narrative – testing a goat, a lemon, and a watermelon for the coronavirus – soon died under suspicious circumstances. Reflecting on viewers' comments in the chat about the "Heavenly Jerusalem" project in **Ukraine**, Filip mentions the history of the **Khazars**, and reminds viewers that Israeli Prime Minister **Netanyahu** actually originates from **Poland** with the original surname **Mileikowsky**. All of this, the host concludes, confirms that world politics is just a big play to the detriment of ordinary people who suffer inflation, fear of war, and digitalization.

sections.subtitle: Political spectacle with Mike Tyson and a morbid debate on broadcasting the death penalty live
sections.screenshot_description: Donald J. Trump and boxer Mike Tyson together on stage during a campaign rally.
sections.content:
Continuing the topic of American politics as a pro-wrestling spectacle, **Filip** shows footage from a campaign rally where **Donald J. Trump** is joined on stage by the famous boxer **Mike Tyson** ("Iron Mike"), also providing support to Congressman **Bruce Blakeman**. The host notices that Trump uses exclusively sports terminology – he talks about "fighting for the **Senate**" and **Congress** ahead of the upcoming *midterm* elections and brags about how they "sold out every arena". For Filip, this is proof that the entire political scene is set up like a rigged, scripted sport.

However, behind the scenes of this entertainment, a much darker story is unfolding. Filip plays a clip discussing a man sentenced to death for the alleged murder of 13 or 14 American soldiers, and reveals that a serious debate is currently underway in **America** about whether his execution before a firing squad will be broadcast live via *live stream*. Individuals from the Trump administration, including **Pete Hegseth** (whom he phonetically calls "Pita Hackett" in the broadcast and describes as a former drunkard), openly support the idea and want to personally attend the execution.

Filip sharply condemns such a concept, pointing out that matters of life and death belong exclusively to God, not man. He especially emphasizes the hypocrisy of those who announced Trump's return as the arrival of light and the end of **Biden's** "culture of death", while now the most direct form of the culture of death is being promoted – a public execution by firing squad unseen since World War II. The host wonders what normal person would even want to watch the moment someone is killed, and expresses disgust at the fact that such a broadcast, perhaps even on a *pay-per-view* model like the one used by pro-wrestlers, would probably attract a billion viewers. Still, he adds that people alone are not to blame for this, but rather decades of systematic work on lowering humanity to the lowest passions. Looking back on his former days when he followed the *QAnon* movement and stories about the hanging of **Hillary** and the fall of the cabal, Filip admits that today he would no longer want to see even such footage because he does not want to be a witness to any morbid rituals.

sections.subtitle: Russian diesel for America and how Mike Tyson saved the WWE in 1998 – and is now saving Trump
sections.screenshot_description: Archival photograph of Mike Tyson and wrestler Stone Cold Steve Austin from 1998 in a WWE ring.
sections.content:
Returning to the topic of energy sources, **Filip** shows a clip in which **Donald J. Trump** brags about a major deal under which **Russia** will deliver millions of tons of diesel to the American and world markets. The host points out the complete absurdity and "urinating" on the public: the same man who two years ago demonized **Europe** for buying Russian energy and openly bragged about destroying **Nord Stream 2**, is now triumphantly announcing the import of Russian diesel into the **USA**. For Filip, this is not ordinary hypocrisy, but proof that politicians are merely actors and slaves performing assigned roles without room for independent maneuver.

In doing so, he briefly reflects on the hypocrisy in **Croatia** as well, reminding viewers how in 2018 – at a time when **Crimea** had already been annexed – many Croats enthusiastically traveled to **Moscow** for the World Cup, led by then-President **Kolinda** who thanked the Russians in Russian, only to turn around overnight later and start shouting "Glory to **Ukraine**" as soon as the media served them a new narrative. Filip reveals an additional dimension of the mockery with Russian diesel through concrete numbers: the initial deal foresees the delivery of 36 million barrels of diesel, which sounds impressive until one looks at actual consumption – that amount is enough for only ten days of consumption in the USA, or seven days in Europe.

In the final part of this segment, along with a brief digression about the strange height ratio between Trump and Tyson on stage, the host explains in detail why precisely **Mike Tyson** was brought into the campaign. Due to the policy toward **Israel**, the war in **Iran**, fuel prices, and high inflation, Republicans are standing poorly ahead of the elections, and promises of resolving the war in Ukraine in one day have not been fulfilled either. Therefore, they need a savior, and Tyson already played that role in 1998 when he saved the struggling pro-wrestling federation **WWE** (formerly **WWF**, owned by **Vince McMahon**, while his wife **Linda McMahon** is today the Secretary of Education in the USA). Back then, McMahon took a risk and hired Tyson just after the boxer had been convicted of rape, gone bankrupt, and bitten off **Holyfield's** ear. Alongside wrestling star **Stone Cold Steve Austin** at *WrestleMania 14*, Tyson caused excitement among the audience and turned the organization's fate around. Today, 28 years later, the US administration is trying to pull off the same *re-run* in the political ring.

iterations.theme: Technocracy, artificial intelligence, universal income, and theories about the replacement of public figures

sections.subtitle: Awarding medals to tech giants and Donald J. Trump's change in rhetoric toward Big Tech
sections.screenshot_description: Footage of awarding medals to tech leaders and a speech by Donald J. Trump.
sections.content:
Host Filip opens a new topic by reminding viewers of the gathering of tech leaders around Donald J. Trump, among whom Jeff Bezos, Elon Musk, Mark Zuckerberg, Michael Dell, Sam Altman, and Larry Ellison are mentioned. Filip points out that Trump stated these companies would monitor themselves and have a parallel system related to managing artificial intelligence. He specifically reflects on the moment Trump presented a medal to Elon Musk and lists everyone who received the National Medal of Technology and Innovation: **Microsoft, Dell, AMD, Elon Musk, Jensen (Nvidia), and Google**.

To point out political duplicity and the continuity of the agenda regardless of who is in power — whether Republicans or Democrats, from Obama and Biden to Trump's *Stargate* project — the host shows archival footage. In it, Donald J. Trump previously sharply attacks Silicon Valley and *Big Tech*, calling Google and Facebook corrupt, while describing Mark Zuckerberg as a *weirdo*. Filip then compares that old rhetoric with new footage in which Trump calls those very same people the greatest minds in the world who should be allowed to regulate themselves.

The host draws a direct parallel between the self-regulation of tech giants and the pharmaceutical industry. He recalls the earlier mentioned case with the agency HALMED and Dr. Alma Demirović, pointing out how pharmaceutical companies also conduct internal controls and write reports and declarations themselves, while regulatory agencies merely stamp them without real verification.

sections.subtitle: Promises versus the reality of artificial intelligence: job losses and military surveillance
sections.screenshot_description: Collage of media reports on the military application of artificial intelligence and mass surveillance.
sections.content:
Analyzing the promises that tech industry leaders give to the public, Filip shows a compilation of statements taken from Jon Stewart's show. In these clips, tech leaders promise that artificial intelligence will improve the quality of the human experience, create superhumans, and eradicate poverty and diseases like cancer, heart disease, and Alzheimer's. In contrast to these utopian announcements, the host shows the other side of the coin — the actual current application of artificial intelligence, which includes:
- disinformation campaigns to influence elections
- cyberattacks and hacking
- mass surveillance systems of citizens
- military technology and autonomous drones.

The host emphasizes that the leaders of this industry always place all positive effects into a distant and indefinite future ("one day"), while in the present, technology is used for surveillance and repression. He devotes special attention to the impact of artificial intelligence on the labor market. In the shown clips, Elon Musk states that probably none of us will have a job, and that people will work only as a hobby, while other experts admit that many jobs will disappear, and what the new jobs will look like — they currently cannot even imagine.

As the pinnacle of absurdity, Filip singles out a statement by Nvidia boss Jensen, who cites *wellness* and *spa* centers as an example of a job of the future that once did not exist. The host ironically comments that the head of one of the most important tech companies obviously does not know that thermal baths and *wellness* have existed since the times of Sumer, Egypt, and ancient Rome. He also reflects on statements by the creators of artificial intelligence themselves, who with a smile on their faces estimate that there is between a 10 and 25 percent chance that their technology will completely destroy humanity, justifying further development with the claim that American "killer robots" are better than Chinese ones.

sections.subtitle: The idea of universal basic income and campaign promises of 5,000 dollars
sections.screenshot_description: Donald J. Trump at a campaign rally promising a payout of 5,000 dollars to voters.
sections.content:
Building upon the announcements of disappearing jobs, Filip warns about the introduction of **universal basic income** (or universal high income, as Elon Musk calls it). The host describes this concept as the pinnacle of communist dystopia and totalitarianism, in which the state and "Big Brother" give citizens money for survival, whereby people become complete slaves to the system. He connects this with the introduction of programmable digital currencies, where it will no longer be possible to build savings; instead, citizens will receive monthly amounts resembling vouchers that they must spend, and any rebellion against the system could result in repression and the blocking of funds.

To show that even allegedly capitalist-oriented politicians are pushing the same agenda, Filip shows a clip of a speech by Donald J. Trump. In that speech, Trump promises that if Republicans keep the House of Representatives and the Senate, he will pay **5,000 dollars** to every adult who goes to the polls and votes. The host asks a logical question: if the American economy is doing as well as claimed, why is the state handing out money to citizens at all?

Filip reminds viewers of the paradox in which Elon Musk was brought into the administration at the beginning of the term to cut costs and reduce the massive US public debt through the DOGE department, and now, despite the fact that the debt has not been reduced, voters are openly offered money in exchange for a vote. The host compares this to a past statement by former Croatian President Kolinda Grabar-Kitarović about 8,000 euros, noting that she at least spoke about a salary for work done, whereas in America citizens are being accustomed to direct state payouts as an introduction to universal income.

sections.subtitle: The Pentagon's LifeLog project, the background of the creation of Facebook and Amazon, and viewers' comments
sections.screenshot_description: Display of data on the shutting down of the Pentagon's LifeLog project and the founding of Facebook on the same day.
sections.content:
Continuing the show, Filip debunks myths about the spontaneous creation of the biggest tech giants. He recalls the Pentagon's **LifeLog** project, whose goal was to track the entire life of individuals — what they do, who they socialize with, and what they watch. This military project was officially terminated on **February 4, 2004**, on the exact same day that **Facebook** was founded. The host explains that the public would never have voluntarily accepted such a system had it borne the stamp of military technology and the Pentagon, so a movie-like story was created about a student from MIT or Harvard who spontaneously launches a social network in a dorm room.

A similar background, the host points out, belongs to **Amazon** as well. Instead of the popular story about Jeff Bezos's humble beginnings in a garage, Filip shows data connecting the creation of Amazon with the Pentagon, stating that Bezos's grandfather was a co-founder of the agency ARPA (later DARPA). To emphasize that Eastern powers are not outside this technocratic system either, the host presents the datum that Russia currently counts 188 *data* centers.

During a short break to read viewers' comments in the live broadcast, Filip responds to remarks about the state of the world. To a viewer's comment that the acceleration of the agenda resembles the fall of the Roman Empire and the Venetian Republic because time is running out for the elites, the host expresses his opinion that the current chaos is not a consequence of panic among the powerful, but rather a **controlled demolition** of the existing system, similar to the events of September 11. Referring to projections by the **Club of Rome** from the 1960s, which predicted global crises precisely for the period of the 2030s and 2040s, Filip concludes that the ground is being подготовлен according to plan for a new system, while human police and military are gradually being replaced by robots and drones to avoid the possibility of law enforcement forces taking the side of the people.

sections.subtitle: The Trump Account program for children, Susan Dell's appearance, and an analysis of Fred Trump's appearance
sections.screenshot_description: Footage of Susan Dell's speech at the presentation of the financial program for children.
sections.content:
Moving on to the topic from the show's thumbnail, Filip presents the program of so-called **Trump Accounts** (*Trump Account*) for children. According to this program, every child in America receives 1,000 dollars from the state into an account at the start, while parents continue to deposit funds themselves, which the child can dispose of upon turning 18. The host notes that the program resembles a model that already exists in Israel, but expresses deep skepticism toward what the world and the financial system will even look like in 18 years.

The main focus of this segment is the public appearance of **Susan Dell**, wife of Michael Dell, who promoted the mentioned program. Filip plays footage of her speech, drawing viewers' attention to the extremely unusual, stiff posture of her hands and the drastically altered appearance of her face. Comparing her old photographs, in which she looks like a completely ordinary woman, with her appearance today, the host asks whether this is even the same person.

Analyzing the details of her face, Filip zooms in on an unusual skin fold and structure around the ear and jaw, which directly reminds him of photographs of **Fred Trump**, the father of Donald J. Trump. Showing authentic photographs of Fred Trump, the host points out the identical, unnatural anatomy of the jaw and ear. Additionally, Filip shows photographs from a ceremony in which guests and the Dell family, after a donation of 750 million dollars for medicine, show the symbol of the *Devil's Horns* with their hands, emphasizing the position of the thumb, which rules out the interpretation that it is the sign for love in sign language.

sections.subtitle: Comparison of photographs and tattoos of a footballer before and after the World Cup
sections.screenshot_description: Comparative display of tattoos and the appearance of a footballer before and after the World Cup.
sections.content:
Continuing the topic of strange changes in the appearance of public figures, Filip moves to the world of football and presents a theory circulating on the internet about a famous footballer. According to the official narrative, the player underwent jaw surgery after the World Cup, but the host shows a series of comparative photographs from before and after the tournament that raise the question of whether it is the same man.

Analyzing the attached photographs, Filip points out several drastic differences:
- **Leg tattoos:** In photographs before the World Cup, the footballer's left leg is completely covered in tattoos, whereas in photographs after the tournament, those tattoos are not there at all.
- **Arm tattoos:** Before the tournament, the player had an image of Jesus Christ tattooed on his left arm, whereas in later footage, there is a completely different tattoo in the same place.
- **Physical characteristics:** The host notices changes in his gaze and eyes, a different shade of skin color, as well as a noticeably thinner build and less muscle mass in the legs.

In discussion with viewers, who note in the comments that the player on the field no longer knows how to run or dribble like before (alongside a recent appearance against Villarreal), Filip points out that in the 21st century, when public figures post every step on social media, there is no record of the footballer going for laser tattoo removal, nor is it possible to remove an old tattoo and make a new one over it in just a few weeks.

sections.subtitle: Final conversation with viewers about ecology and the show's sign-off
sections.screenshot_description: Host Filip in the studio commenting on viewers' messages and ecological problems in Croatia.
sections.content:
In the final part of the show, Filip reflects on viewers' comments and thanks the audience for the great response to his recent interview with a chemist about the problem of pollution and waste. Reading a message from a viewer from Split, who states that the water in the city has not been drinkable for years as soon as heavier rain falls in autumn and winter, the host expresses indignation at the fact that Croatia is God-given with natural resources and water sources, which interest groups and the mafia are systematically destroying.

Filip recalls a clip from Aleksandar Stanković's show featuring environmental activist **Vjeran Piršić**. He retells Piršić's anecdote from 2003 or 2004, at the time when footballer **Niko Kranjčar** was transferring from Dinamo to Hajduk. While around ten thousand people were enthusiastically welcoming Kranjčar at Poljud, only a few environmental activists were trying to stop trucks that were illegally transporting hazardous waste to an inadequate landfill. The man who stood in front of the truck with his body back then — like the famous protester at China's Tiananmen Square — ended up arrested. The host agrees with Piršić's assessment that society is "lobotomized" by football and other trivial things that serve to divert attention from key life problems.

Before the sign-off itself, Filip briefly mentions that he also had a block prepared for the show about an alleged heroic act on an airplane on a flight from Dubai to Israel, but gave up due to a lack of time. He only briefly notes that the story is full of illogic — from the claim by the "hero" from Mossad that he knew what to do because he watched documentaries about plane crashes, to the lie that he struggled to open the cockpit door onto which the dead pilot had fallen, even though the doors in that type of aircraft open outward. He concludes the show by thanking all viewers and donors who make the channel's work possible.
